claims.text: Hyperparameters explored include vector dimension size (ranging from 50 to 1,000 dimensions), vocabulary sizes (30,000 to 3,000,000), and learning rates.
The study extended the exploration of dimensions up to 3,000 and noted diminishing returns after a certain point.
The choice of hyperparameters is crucial as the wrong combinations can lead to poor quality vectors.
